entries.category_description: Supply of services by writers, composers and performing artists, or of the royalties due to them
entries.comment: According to Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category XXIX, 2°, the services relating to the performance of theatrical, choreographic, musical works, circus, music hall or artistic cabaret shows and similar activities, which fall within the normal activity of actors, conductors'orchestra, musicians and other artists, even if these services are provided by a legal person with the exception of the advertising services. The reduced rate applies to 90.01 and 90.03 in that context.

entries.category_description: Supply of services by writers, composers and performing artists, or of the royalties due to them
entries.comment: Writing contracts connected with theatrical performances, vocal and instrumental concerts, circus activities, puppet shows, etc., as well as the relative performances, rendered by intermediaries
